extract_cpp_docstrings: run mkdoc.py on C++ header files to extract Doxygen comments into Python docstrings
process_doxygen_comment: process a raw C++ comment string to convert Doxygen tags to Markdown formatting
sanitize_cpp_name: sanitize a C++ symbol name by replacing operators and special characters for Python docstring variable names
write_docstring_header: write a C header file containing static docstring variables and DOC macro definitions for pybind11 bindings
extract_all_comments: extract documentation comments from multiple C++ header files in parallel using clang libclang
